title: Avoid repeating the journey in compact checkpoint responses
body:
Retained MCP tool responses from three successful Claude playtests contain 332 tool calls and 1,445,215 UTF-8 response bytes. Fifteen choose_overworld_session_journey replies account for 161,178 bytes. Their nested result.journey fields alone account for 39,063 bytes, while each envelope already exposes the current journey at the top level.

Source inspection confirms that choose_overworld_session_journey passes an identity result formatter to OverworldMcpSessionStore.run, even when compact_result defaults to true. Unlike the envelope's compact journey, that nested value is the full JourneyPresentation, so it also bypasses compact story-choice disclosure. The full API and engine contract should remain available when compact_result is false.

Add an honest compact result projection that carries the retention event and exact exit receipt once, using the existing top-level journey for current status, goals, checkpoints, and choices. Preserve explicit full-result callers, error handling, paused RPG resumption, deterministic state/proof hashes, and the pure server's receipt recording/retry behavior. Verify through real API and pure transport tests, retain a regression that fails before the fix, independently review the change, and measure actual serialized response savings. Byte measurements are not model token counts or billed savings.

The local profile and three retained provider transcripts are under audit-world-validation/ai-runs/playtest. Published session records retain their exact provider transcript digests; the complete provider transcripts remain ignored local evidence.
